name: pmUSD
oneLiner: pmUSD is RAAC's f(x)-fork dollar fToken minted against TokenBlender/ION.au gold collateral; xPM absorbs volatility and sUSDS-based PSM defends the peg.
collateral: TokenBlender (TB) base token held on-chain in RAAC's RWf(x) Treasury; TB is minted against I-ON Digital's ION.au token held in the TokenBlender contract, and ION.au represents a gold-backed digital security and in-situ gold claim
pegMechanism: RWf(x), an f(x) protocol fork, mints pmUSD as the fToken against TB / ION.au-linked collateral; xPM absorbs collateral-price volatility while pmUSD is configured for stable fNAV; minting and system operations are manager-only through authorized silo multisigs. PSM (Peg Stability Module) is the only par venue: one-directional pmUSD → sUSDS swaps at $1 that pause below a 20% reserve floor, but it held only ~33k sUSDS on 2026-10-30 (~0.04% of supply), so it is not a material backstop

proofOfReserves.provider: Chainlink Proof of Reserve / Instruxi (ion-por feed: 86400s heartbeat with 2% deviation threshold; measures I-ON Digital's total reserve, not a pmUSD-specific reconciliation against the ION.au tranche pledged to RAAC)
